purpose: Prior-art boundaries for a proposed Manor workspace repair research prototype.
search_scope: Selected closest primary papers and official repositories; not an exhaustive novelty search.

works.title: BoardroomAI: Dependency-Aware Human-Steerable Multi-Agent Deliberation through Evolving Decision Graphs
overlap: Typed dependency graphs, alternative justifications, selective specialist repair, preservation and confidence-based full fallback.
Random missing-edge stress testing and repair-context closure already proposed.
limits: Synthetic graph experiments and a small prototype pilot; canonical pilot dependencies mechanically constructed.
Fallback disabled in missing-edge experiment; reported decision-sufficient closure not evaluated.
works.baseline_use: Adapt signature propagation and declared fallback; clearly label adaptation, not a reproduction.
works.novelty_risk: Graph routing plus selective regeneration or edge-deletion stress tests are established.

works.title: MEMOREPAIR: Barrier-First Cascade Repair in Agentic Memory
overlap: Withdraw invalidated derived artifacts, rebuild validated successors, enforce predecessor closure and optimize repair selection by min-cut.
Source corrections, deletions, migrations and missing influence edges already studied.
limits: Complete influence provenance and validation coverage are explicit assumptions.
Random deletion of 1% of influence edges reports 17.7% leakage; this is a reported result, not independently reproduced.
works.baseline_use: Cascade repair using the same repair operator and observed graph; report completeness assumptions.
works.novelty_risk: Cascade update, barrier-first repair, predecessor closure and min-cut are prior art.

works.title: LEDGER: Scaling Agentic Document Editing with Dependency-aware Graph Retrieval
works.date_type: arXiv v1 submission; ACL Findings2026 publication separately confirmed
works.source_type: primary preprint full text plus publisher landing page
overlap: Typed explicit, implicit, containment and semantic dependencies guide context retrieval.
Counterfactual LLM tests infer directional implicit dependencies; consistency verification and incremental graph refresh are already included.
limits: Structured-document focus; missing or wrong extraction can propagate.
External edits may desynchronize the graph; graph construction cost must be counted.
works.baseline_use: Counterfactual extraction plus verification under a matched total token budget, not only flat semantic RAG.
works.novelty_risk: Semantic audit or counterfactual dependency inference alone is not new.

works.title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
overlap: Judges duties involving state use, information handoffs and final-state agreement using explicit execution evidence.
Extracted relationships support diagnosis and corrective continuation.
limits: Recovery gate acts before commitment; compensation of committed external effects is out of scope.
works.baseline_use: Useful conceptual evidence/diagnosis comparator; not directly a cross-file editing method.
works.novelty_risk: Correct memory alone does not prove compliant execution; this distinction is already formalized.

works.title: CodePlan: Repository-level Coding using LLMs and Planning
works.date_type: initial arXiv submission; FSE2024 acceptance confirmed by official repo
works.source_type: primary preprint and author organization repository
overlap: Incremental dependencies, change-impact analysis and adaptive multi-file edit plans.
limits: Static code structure differs from heterogeneous generated workspace deliverables.
Official repository describes data and evaluation scripts; do not claim the original method was executed unless it actually was.
works.baseline_use: Conceptual precedent; any independent adaptation must be labeled.
works.novelty_risk: Dependency-aware adaptive edit planning is established.

works.title: Finite-Sample Coverage Audits for High-Recall Candidate Generation: Certification and Learning-Theoretic Design
overlap: Excluded-pool auditing, exact hypergeometric inversion, missed-mass certification and sample-size planning.
limits: Candidate generator/family and audit rule fixed before certification labels.
Finite-corpus probability refers to audit randomization, not model truth or future populations.
Oracle relevance labels and stable population needed; semantic repair correctness is outside the certificate.
works.baseline_use: Attribute the statistical machinery; a workspace-specific application is not a new audit theorem.
works.novelty_risk: Excluded-pool certification and its label-complexity principle already exist.

works.title: Exact Finite-Population Sequential Auditing for Selective Release from Model-Proposed Candidate Sets
works.source_type: primary journal publisher metadata and abstract returned in search
works.verified_scope: Publisher title, authors, dates, citation, abstract. Direct article/HTML/XML/PDF fetch attempts returned429/unavailable; do not imply full-text line-by-line verification.
overlap: Candidate and audit plan frozen before outcomes; uniform sampling without replacement controls release, continued review or full review.
Exact hypergeometric recursion evaluates unsafe-release probabilities and workload.
limits: Audit randomization operating characteristics; retrospective development choices do not establish observed operational savings.
works.baseline_use: Cite as established selective-release audit machinery; verify detailed algorithm before any faithful reproduction.
works.novelty_risk: Sequential finite-population selective release is established; no new statistical theorem claimed.

works.title: Grounded Continuation: A Linear-Time Runtime Verifier for LLM Conversations
overlap: Interpreted epistemic operations maintain a dependency map; retraction propagates and deterministic checks identify unsupported continuations.
limits: Conversational grounding rather than heterogeneous deliverable editing.
works.baseline_use: Related work for belief revision and claim support.
works.novelty_risk: Epistemic dependency maintenance and retraction propagation are established.

recommended_gap.question: How should limited checks be allocated outside an observed dependency graph to discover natural missing/wrong dependencies and repair cross-file workspace outputs?
distinguishing_evidence_needed: Natural extraction failures, beyond injected edge deletion.
Matched total cost including extraction, construction, audit, fallback and repair.
Held-out workspace families and task-level final correctness.
Version-pinned before/after artifacts and valid human-edit preservation.
recommended_gap.prototype_boundary: Deterministic routing with oracle labels is a bounded systems experiment; it is not evidence of autonomous semantic repair or model improvement.

recommended_baselines: BoardroomAI-inspired signature propagation and declared fallback
LEDGER-style counterfactual dependency extraction plus verification
MemoRepair-inspired cascade with identical repair operators
claims_to_avoid: New exact hypergeometric or finite-population audit theorem
Production integration based only on static source inspection
State-of-the-art AI repair from synthetic routing simulations
